arguments.summary: Credential compromise incident attributed to APT29 (Cozy Bear) observed via Cobalt Strike beaconing from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42). Adversary conducted Kerberoasting attacks against high-privilege service accounts (svc_sql_prod, svc_exchange_admin, svc_sccm) using RC4-encrypted TGS requests. Initial access vector identified as phishing-induced PowerShell execution leading to lateral movement and domain controller reconnaissance. No evidence of data exfiltration or ransomware deployment observed during monitoring window.

arguments.summary: Anomalous outbound traffic from host 10.0.5.22 (WS-FIN-042) to known malicious IP 198.51.100.23 over HTTPS was detected. EDR and NDR tools identified suspicious processes including rundll32.exe and powershell.exe exhibiting C2 beaconing behavior. SIEM correlation revealed prior Cobalt Strike beacon alerts and lateral movement attempts via SMB. Despite sandbox analysis returning 'clean', behavioral indicators and IOCs confirm compromise. Administrative containment actions were denied due to mismatched targeting, highlighting response coordination gaps.

timeline.description: Initial reconnaissance: External IP 198.51.100.44 scanned internal asset 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101).
Compromised host 10.0.5.42 (WS-FIN-042) established outbound HTTPS connection to 198.51.100.23.
Suspicious rundll32.exe execution detected from Temp directory on WS-FIN-042.
IDS triggered on 'ET TROJAN Cobalt Strike Beacon C2' signature for traffic from WS-FIN-042.
Failed Kerberos TGT request from WS-FIN-042, indicating potential credential brute-force or relay attempt.
Lateral movement detected: SMB access from WS-FIN-042 to file server 10.0.5.50.
Anomalous traffic alert raised on 10.0.5.22 (incorrectly reported; actual source was 10.0.5.42).
EDR data confirms malicious activity on WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), including encoded PowerShell and unsigned DLL loading.
Containment actions failed due to incorrect target IP (10.0.5.22 vs actual 10.0.5.42), exposing alert misattribution flaw.
